enunciado: Go through the sentence "El codigo es poesia" character by character and count vowels, consonants and spaces. Use index_of on reference strings to classify each character.
objetivos: Classify characters with a reference string
pistas: Convert the sentence to lower case first to avoid duplicate cases.
index_of("aeiou", c) >= 0 means c is a vowel.
Consonants are letters that are not vowels.
